dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Fourteen datasets contributed to the normative GMV model (HC train/test + cases). HCP 150 was used as an independent HC sample for functional-circuit mapping.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "We examined data for 1,465 HCs... and 1,294 cases, taken from 14 different studies"; "We then trained a normative model... in a training set comprising 1,196 HCs"; "The remaining 269 controls... were held out as a test set"; "we took each region showing an extreme deviation in each participant... in an independent sample of 150 unrelated HCs (HCP 150 ) to establish the normative pattern of expected FC"; "This study used neuroimaging data collected across multiple independent datasets..."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: study_1/Segal2023.pdf.md: Sample characteristics / Normative modeling; study_1/41593_2023_1404_MOESM2_ESM.pdf.md: Policy information about availability of data
